parts.label: The Hook
parts.sceneDirection: Leo inside a colorful virtual kitchen. A giant pizza appears with glowing fraction symbols floating around it.

beats.speaker: leo
beats.line: Whoa! Doraemon, I found a pizza party game, but it says I need to share the pizza equally with my friends. How do I know how much pizza each person gets?

beats.speaker: guide
beats.stageDirection: Doraemon pulls out a 'Fraction Finder Gadget' with a sparkle animation.
beats.line: No worries, Leo! You've just discovered the secret code of parts and wholes. A whole thing can be split into smaller equal parts, and fractions help us describe those pieces!

beats.speaker: leo
beats.line: So fractions are like a game map showing how much of the treasure we collected?

beats.speaker: guide
beats.line: Exactly! You're about to unlock the 'Fraction Explorer' skill!

parts.label: The Core Breakdown
parts.sceneDirection: A whole pizza divides into 2, then 4 equal slices. Each slice glows as Doraemon points to it.

beats.speaker: guide
beats.line: Imagine this pizza is one complete object. We call it a whole. If we split it into equal pieces, each piece becomes a part of that whole.

beats.speaker: leo
beats.line: So if I cut the pizza into 4 equal slices, every slice is one part of the same pizza?

beats.speaker: guide
beats.line: Correct! Since the pizza is divided into 4 equal parts, each slice is called one-fourth. We write it as 1/4.

parts.label: Interactive Diagnostic Pause
parts.prompt: Imagine a chocolate bar is divided into 3 equal pieces. You eat 1 piece. What fraction of the chocolate did you eat?
parts.explanation: The whole was divided into 3 equal parts, and we are talking about 1 of those parts.

parts.label: The Lightbulb Moment
parts.sceneDirection: Leo sharing a cake with friends. Fraction symbols glow around equal pieces.

beats.speaker: leo
beats.line: Ohhh! Fractions aren't just numbers. They're like labels that tell us how much of something we have compared to the whole!

beats.speaker: guide
beats.line: That's the idea! Whether it's pizza, cake, a toy collection, or a drawing, fractions help us understand pieces of a complete thing.

beats.speaker: guide
beats.line: XP Unlocked: You learned that a fraction shows how many equal parts we have out of the total parts in a whole!
